items.title: Sonny Williams Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: Old Tabla and Kato played bass with him too.

ctx.x: Yes, I heard you. They had him, Zep, his brother. Who else? On bass. Old Tabla and Kato played bass with him too. They didn't keep no one bunch of color all the time. They changed up.
What's Tabs for it? Full line? Tab-a-line?
